environment.runner: fresh Codex collaboration sub-agent per scored case

evaluated_skill_snapshot.legacy_hash_scope: not unambiguously documented; do not compare it to the whole-file hash or current SKILL.md

release_use.reason: The evaluated artifact predates the executable casefile, validator, workflow, recovery, eval-context, and packaging runtime.

known_limitations: The runner did not expose provider run IDs or immutable backend logs for inclusion.
Earlier v1 through v6 SKILL.md states were not saved as hashed snapshots.
Raw records were transcribed into local files from agent outputs and are not cryptographically attested by the provider.
Two v6 calls ended with stream disconnects and produced no scoreable output; fresh retries were used and the failed calls were not counted.
The legacy declared skill hash had an ambiguous scope; the retained snapshot whole-file hash is recorded separately.
